_description: Entry Academic — designed for students and candidates with under 2 years of experience. Education section leads. Dark shaded section headings with white text create clear visual hierarchy without relying on color in body text. One page optimised. Research: 82% of organisations use ATS even for entry-level roles (Enhancv 2025), so this template remains ATS-safe despite the shaded headings. Inline skill categories signal technical literacy despite limited work history.
_edit_instructions: Change heading_fill_color to change the section heading background. heading_text_color should stay FFFFFF (white) unless you choose a very light fill. All values are 6-digit hex without the # symbol.
